target_text:
Have you ever wanted to visit a new place in the world? If so, what would you choose to visit? One place I would choose to visit is Thailand. I chose Thailand because there is many fun and cool new things to do there. In Thailand you can go to a really beautiful beach, visit different towns, and try or do new things.

The beach in Thailand has many benefits. There is many activities I would do at the beach. One thing I can do is go scuba diving to see and swim with many sea creatures such as fishes, dolphins, and sharks.

Also there is a very beautiful coral reef beach I would want to go to. The beach in Thailand would be very relaxing. Thailands beach has many beautiful and amazing sights that I would want to see.

In Thailand there are many different towns I want to visit. In the towns there are many cool things I could buy. Also I would probably see lots of animals there like birds, dogs, or even farm animals walking, or flying around, which I would I like to see. While i'm walking around the town I could end up seeing new things that I've probably never seen before such as people doing unique performances.

There are many things to do in Thailand, some I probably have never done. Such as trying new exotic food. Usually, I would end up liking the new food I try or sometimes not. Exploring in Thailand is something really fun that i would want to do, I probably could end up finding places people didn't even know existed. Lastly, one of many other things to do in Thailand that i would want to do is to visit popular sights or buildings.

So have you thought of a place you would like to visit yet? Would you want to visit Thailand?

Thailand is one of the places in the world that I would like to go and visit. I think Thailand would be a very fun place to go. Mostly because of the beautiful beach, the different towns to visit, and the new fun things that I could do. Visiting new places can benefit you, you could end up learning something you didn' know.
